I've written the profile settings form to `./solution.tsx`. I haven't run it, since I can't run code here.

It uses the Orrery kit (`Card`, `Field`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Button`), so it follows whichever brand is active. Colours and spacing come from the brand variables.

- **Display name:** a text field with the hint "Shown to your crew."
- **Time zone:** a select with UTC, Berlin and Tokyo and the placeholder "Choose a time zone".
- **Email switch:** a switch labelled "Email me about new orbits".
- **Save profile:** a primary submit button. After a save, the status text "Profile saved." appears next to it, and it clears again when you edit any field.
